tools.name: get_all_lists
tools.description: Get All Lists - Retrieve all contact lists with optional filtering. Note: boolean filters (starred/archived) are unreliable. Supported filters: folder, search, sortBy, sortType, integration. Each list includes a `fields` array — the list's columns in snake_case (e.g. first_name, email, lead_score).

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return (default: 100)

skip.description: Number of lists to skip for pagination (default: 0)

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a List - Create a new, empty contact list. It needs source (csv_upload, crm_import, lead_database, form_signup, existing_customer or event_attendee) and source_reference (where the contacts came from: the file name, CRM, lead database export, form or event); calls without them are rejected, and both are stored with the list. This tool takes no email addresses; add contacts afterwards with add_contacts, which needs the same two fields. Recipients are the contacts the account holder supplies. Blocklist and unsubscribes are always enforced. The response includes a `fields` array — the list's columns in snake_case (e.g. first_name, email).

folder.description: Optional general folder ID to organize the list. Must be a folder created without a type (i.e., not an email-sender folder).

verification.description: Enable email verification for contacts in this list

archive_invalid.description: Archive contacts with invalid emails after verification

archive_risky.description: Archive contacts with risky emails after verification

source.description: REQUIRED. Where these contacts came from. lead_database: an export from a B2B data provider such as Apollo or ZoomInfo that the account holder is licensed to use.

source_reference.description: REQUIRED. Where the contacts came from: the file name, CRM, lead database export (e.g. 'Apollo export'), form or event. Describes the actual source.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

tools.name: get_list

It also includes `verification_status`: not_required, running (email verification still in progress; valid/risky/invalid counts are not final), paused (out of verification credits), no_leads (the list is still empty) or done.

tools.name: create_sequence
tools.description: Create a Sequence - Create a new email sequence/campaign. Recipients are the contacts the account holder supplies. Blocklist and unsubscribes are always enforced. The sequence is always created PAUSED and sends nothing. To start sending, use update_sequence_status with status ACTIVE, which needs the user's confirmation.

lists.description: Array of list UUIDs to include in the sequence

folder.description: Optional general folder ID to organize the sequence. Must be a folder created without a type (i.e., not an email-sender folder).

launchTimingMode.description: Launch timing used once the sequence is activated: 'now' (default) or 'schedule'. The sequence stays paused either way until update_sequence_status sets it ACTIVE.

scheduledAt.description: Launch time used once the sequence is activated. UTC milliseconds OR an ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. '2026-07-08T16:30:00+05:30' for 4:30 PM IST. Required when launchTimingMode='schedule'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for scheduled sending, e.g. 'Asia/Calcutta' or 'America/New_York'. Required when launchTimingMode='schedule'; otherwise it defaults to UTC.

autoTagReplies.description: Tag each reply's outcome with AI. Defaults to true when your plan includes AI reply tagging. Works only when checkEmailReply is on.

enabled.description: Whether sending is enabled on this day

emailSendingHours.description: Custom email sending hours for each day of the week (Monday-Sunday). Default: weekdays 09:00-17:00 enabled, weekends disabled.

template_id.description: Public template UUID for the email step

send_as.description: How to send this email: 'new' (default) starts a new thread; 'followup' replies in the lead's existing thread as 'Re: <original subject>'. Ignored on the first email step of the sequence, which always starts a new thread.

days.description: Number of days to wait before the next step

steps.description: Sequence steps. Required and non-empty. Each email step must be {type: 'email', template_id: 'public-template-uuid'} with optional send_as: 'new' | 'followup' (followup replies in the existing thread; ignored on the first email step, which always starts a new thread). Each delay step must be {type: 'delay', days: number}.

validEmail.description: Send to contacts with valid email status

riskyEmail.description: Send to contacts with risky email status

invalidEmail.description: Send to contacts with invalid email status

checkEmailOpen.description: Check if recipient opened previous email

checkEmailClick.description: Check if recipient clicked a link in previous email

checkEmailReply.description: Check if recipient replied to previous email

checkEmailBeforeSending.description: Verify email before sending. When enabled user must approve email before they can be sent

stopWhenReplyRecievedWhen.description: When to stop sequence on reply: 'contact' = stop for this contact only, 'contact-with-same-domain' = stop for all contacts sharing the same domain

stopOnOutOfOffice.description: Stop the sequence for a lead when they send an out-of-office or other automatic reply. When false (default), the lead's next emails wait until the day after the return date in the reply.

outOfOfficeWaitDays.description: If an out-of-office or automatic reply has no return date, the number of days after the reply to wait before the lead's next email. Whole number from 1 to 90, default 7. Ignored when stopOnOutOfOffice is true.

bcc.description: BCC email address for all outgoing emails

tools.name: update_sequence
tools.description: Update Sequence Properties. Archiving is handled by archive_sequence. Recipients are the contacts the account holder supplies. Blocklist and unsubscribes are always enforced. Changing only name, starred, folder, stopOnOutOfOffice or outOfOfficeWaitDays leaves the sequence's status as it is. Any other change leaves the sequence PAUSED (a running sequence is paused by the edit), so changed lists, steps or senders never start sending on their own. To start or resume sending, use update_sequence_status with status ACTIVE, which needs the user's confirmation.

folder.description: General folder ID to move the sequence into. Must be a folder created without a type (i.e., not an email-sender folder).

scheduledAt.description: Launch time. UTC milliseconds OR an ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. '2026-07-08T16:30:00+05:30' for 4:30 PM IST.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for sending emails, e.g. 'Asia/Calcutta' or 'America/New_York'

enabled.description: Whether sending is enabled on this day

emailSendingHours.description: Custom email sending hours for each day of the week (Monday-Sunday). Must include all 7 days if provided.

template_id.description: Public template UUID for the email step

send_as.description: How to send this email: 'new' (default) starts a new thread; 'followup' replies in the lead's existing thread as 'Re: <original subject>'. Ignored on the first email step of the sequence, which always starts a new thread.

days.description: Number of days to wait before the next step

steps.description: Modify sequence steps. Each email step must be {type: 'email', template_id: 'public-template-uuid'} with optional send_as: 'new' | 'followup' (followup replies in the existing thread; ignored on the first email step, which always starts a new thread). Each delay step must be {type: 'delay', days: number}. When provided, the entire steps array replaces the existing flowchart.

validEmail.description: Send to contacts with valid email status

riskyEmail.description: Send to contacts with risky email status

invalidEmail.description: Send to contacts with invalid email status

stopWhenReplyRecievedWhen.description: When to stop sequence on reply: 'contact' = stop for this contact only, 'contact-with-same-domain' = stop for all contacts sharing the same domain

stopOnOutOfOffice.description: Stop the sequence for a lead when they send an out-of-office or other automatic reply. When false (default), the lead's next emails wait until the day after the return date in the reply.

outOfOfficeWaitDays.description: If an out-of-office or automatic reply has no return date, the number of days after the reply to wait before the lead's next email. Whole number from 1 to 90, default 7. Ignored when stopOnOutOfOffice is true.

bcc.description: BCC email address for all outgoing emails

tools.name: add_contacts
tools.description: Add Contacts to a List - Add multiple contacts to an existing list. Recipients are the contacts the account holder supplies. Blocklist and unsubscribes are always enforced. Every call must include source (csv_upload, crm_import, lead_database, form_signup, existing_customer or event_attendee) and source_reference (where the contacts came from: the file name, CRM, lead database export, form or event); calls without them are rejected. Both are stored on new contacts; a contact already in the list is updated and keeps its original source. If the list is used by an active sequence that takes new contacts, new contacts are scheduled into it automatically. Contacts are supplied by the account holder, e.g. from a file, a CRM or a lead database export such as Apollo or ZoomInfo. All contact field names use snake_case (e.g. first_name, last_name, email, phone, company_name, job_title, lead_score). Custom snake_case fields are added to the list's columns. The `starred` boolean is a contact setting and is not added as a list column. Contact archiving is handled by archive_contact.

list_id.description: The list ID to add contacts to

starred.description: Mark/unmark the contact as starred. This is a contact setting, not a data field/column.

contacts.description: Array of contact objects to add (max 500). All field names must be snake_case; additional custom snake_case fields are allowed. Include only the fields needed for outreach.

remove_duplicates.description: Automatically remove duplicate emails from the list

source.description: REQUIRED. Where these contacts came from. lead_database: an export from a B2B data provider such as Apollo or ZoomInfo that the account holder is licensed to use.

source_reference.description: REQUIRED. Where the contacts came from: the file name, CRM, lead database export (e.g. 'Apollo export'), form or event. Describes the actual source.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

ramp_up_frequency.description: Daily increment when auto ramp-up is on (1-50)

max_daily_frequency.description: Daily warmup limit (1-50). With auto ramp-up off this is the daily limit; with it on, the ceiling.

starting_warmup_frequency.description: Initial daily limit when auto ramp-up is on (1-50)

warmup_keyword.description: Warmup filter tag: two words joined by a dash, e.g. 'blue-river'. It is included in every warmup email so the user can filter them.

enabled.description: true: send warmup emails only in the slots below. false: send throughout the day.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the slot times are in, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Omitted: keeps the stored timezone (UTC if none).

warmup_schedule.description: Days and time slots when warmup emails and replies may be sent. null switches the schedule off and keeps its days.

pause_cold_emails_when_health_low.description: Pause cold emails when health is low

folder.description: Email-sender folder ID to move the sender into. Must be a folder created with type 'email-sender'. An empty string removes the sender from its current folder.
